rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update autoreconf -vfi
cp -a "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/python3" cp -a "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/libonly"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" mkdir .mybin ln -sf "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/python3.9" .mybin/python3.9 ln -sf "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" \ .mybin/pkg-config
export PATH="$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/.mybin:$PATH"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/python3"
PYTHON_VERSION="3.9" \ CFLAGS="$CFLAGS" CPPFLAGS="$CPPFLAGS" LDFLAGS="-Wl,--as-needed $LDFLAGS" \ ./configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-rpath \ --disable-flto \ --with-pidfile=/run/unbound.pid \ --with-rootkey-file=/var/lib/unbound/root.key \ --with-libevent="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --with-libexpat="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --with-pythonmodule \ --with-pyunbound \ --with-ssl="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --enable-dnstap \ --with-dnstap-socket-path=/run/dnstap.sock \ --libdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/libonly"
PYTHON_VERSION="3.9" \ CFLAGS="$CFLAGS" CPPFLAGS="$CPPFLAGS" LDFLAGS="-Wl,--as-needed $LDFLAGS" \ ./configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --with-libunbound-only \ --disable-rpath \ --disable-flto \ --with-pidfile=/run/unbound.pid \ --with-rootkey-file=/var/lib/unbound/root.key \ --with-libevent="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --with-libexpat="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --without-pythonmodule \ --without-pyunbound \ --with-ssl="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --enable-dnstap \ --with-dnstap-socket-path=/run/dnstap.sock \ --libdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib"
rules.build:
export PATH="$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/.mybin:$PATH"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/python3" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/libonly" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
rules.install:
export PATH="$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/.mybin:$PATH"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/python3" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/libonly" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin/unbound-host" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin"
PYTHON3="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/python3"
cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" find . -name "*.la" -exec rm -f '{}' ';'
cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3" find . -name "*.py" -exec "$PYTHON3" -c "import py_compile; py_compile.compile('{}')" \;
